in_marathi.name: Anarghya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Freedom from pain, sorrow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anarghya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anarghya is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'anargha' which means 'freedom from pain, sorrow, or misery'. It is a name of the Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
